joint_stress.limitations: Finite Monte Carlo diagnostics do not certify coverage or power. The shared-sign control deliberately violates independence. Repeated blocks within a family are not extra independent families. No real judge, model or dialogue evidence.

report.limitations: No composite score. Bounds are not confidence intervals. Missing/N-A scores retain the assignment denominator. Judge provenance is declared, not authenticated. Synthetic/assistant data do not establish real-model or human-calibrated efficacy.
report.target_interpretation: Fixed benchmark estimates describe the observed equal-family/equal-block scores only; no uncertainty for future runs is inferred. Population intervals require independent families and a justified sampling frame; declarations do not establish either.
